recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: payment rails stuttering when the cloud blinks
population clocks ticking slower than the doomsayers promised
open seats appearing in the yc winter hiring orbit
san francisco fog holding ten degrees at dusk
autumn light already retreating before six-thirty
agents waiting to be spun up from a pocket shortcut

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Route falling cloud fragments into the correct bank terminal lanes before the grid goes dark — each misroute adds latency to the whole system.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Clearing one outage wave in under 45 seconds feels like bringing the city back online.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fragments fall faster, a third lane opens, and glitching duplicates appear that must be swiped away.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted grey-blue wireframe with amber transaction sparks

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap in sync with fog pulses rolling across a silhouetted bridge — each beat marks another minute until shipping-by-sunrise deadline.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: A perfect streak triggers a brief golden-hour burst where every tap lands in the sweet spot.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Pulse intervals compress, double-beats sneak in, and mist obscures the timing ring.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor fog gradients over ink-brush skyline

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous wire connecting agent nodes spawned from your phone — link iOS shortcut to GitHub action to CLI without crossing paths.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Completing the circuit in a single unbroken stroke deploys all agents with a satisfying cascade.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: New nodes pop mid-round, crossing your own line erases partial progress, and timeout orbs shrink the drawable window.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon circuit traces on dark glass

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick autumn leaves into shrinking demographic chart arcs — each leaf balances a population curve before the forecast collapses.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Watching a leaf arc perfectly into its slot with a soft thud closes one forecast gap.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind gusts curve trajectories, target arcs narrow, and doomsday leaves try to overshoot on purpose.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout census charts with hand-painted leaves
